link.title: Tutorials for Bitbybit Runner
link.description: Every setting on the legacy BITBYBIT RUNNER theme block. Runner predates the Composer and executes a visual script directly on the storefront, building geometry in the browser from a script you authored in Rete, Blockly or TypeScript. It is documented here because stores configured before the Composer existed still depend on it, and those setups keep working. If you are building something new, use the Composer and the Apps block instead - they cover the same ground with less configuration and a better path to pricing and checkout.
